title: The Quantity a Conditioning Shrink Line Is Taken On
content:
Which bushels the shrink is taken on follows how much of the lot has been worked. This rule governs conditioning shrink on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements and reads the conditioning charges standing on the storage account against the shrink lines that cover them.

## What the schedule provides

Where more than one conditioning charge on the account carries points no shrink line covers, the shrink is taken on the bushels standing in store, the whole lot having been through the dryer.

Where one conditioning charge carries points no shrink line covers and bushels have left store since the grain went in, the shrink is taken on the largest bushels any conditioning charge on the account was raised on.

And otherwise the shrink is taken on the bushels the most recent conditioning charge was raised on.

## The two quantities named

**Bushels standing in store** are backed out of the storage account, being the bushels taken into store less the bushels already taken off for shrink and less the bushels loaded out.

**Conditioning charges carrying points no shrink line covers** are counted as the conditioning charges standing on the account less the shrink lines standing on it, never below nothing.

## Condition and result

| Conditioning charges carrying points no shrink line covers | Bushels have left store since the grain went in | Taken on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than one | either way | the bushels standing in store |
| exactly one | yes | the largest bushels any conditioning charge on the account was raised on |
| exactly one | no | the bushels the most recent conditioning charge was raised on |
| none | either way | the bushels the most recent conditioning charge was raised on |

## Worked quantities, on hypothetical accounts

**An account carrying three conditioning charges and one shrink line, showing 20000 bushels taken in, 150 already off for shrink and 2000 loaded out.** Two conditioning charges carry points no shrink line covers, which is more than one, so the shrink is taken on the bushels standing in store, 17850.

**An account carrying two conditioning charges and one shrink line, with a load-out on the record, the charges having been raised on 6000 and 8300 bushels.** One conditioning charge carries points no shrink line covers and bushels have left store, so the shrink is taken on the largest bushels any conditioning charge was raised on, 8300.

**An account carrying two conditioning charges and one shrink line, with nothing having left store, the most recent charge raised on 6000 bushels.** The shrink is taken on 6000 bushels.
